reading.body:
Actapio operates a dedicated AI infrastructure campus in East Wenatchee, Washington, on a 20-acre site. The operator publishes no IT load figure directly, but third-party facility tracking estimates the campus at approximately 16 megawatts of critical IT load. At a typical density of 40 kilowatts per rack for GPU-based training, this would suggest roughly 400 racks, though this is an estimate pending Actapio's own published specification.

The campus sits third by published megawatts in Washington State, behind two other facilities that together with this one account for 60 megawatts of the state's mapped AI and data center capacity. Washington has 46 mapped facilities overall, of which only two publish power figures, making granular regional capacity assessment difficult and placing Actapio among the few operators disclosing specifications at all.

Actapio is the US operating subsidiary of LY Corporation, a Japanese technology company, and runs this facility as a captive corporate campus rather than third-party colocation. The operator states the site was selected for access to low-cost hydroelectric power and hosts cloud computing, server rental, and application hosting services supporting its parent company's AI model work. No certifications of the campus are published.
